import random, math
N=10000
sums=[]
s=0
for _ in range(N):
    a=random.randint(1,6)
    b=random.randint(1,6)
    sm=a+b
    sums.append(sm)
    s+=sm
min(sums), max(sums), sum(sums), sum(sums)/N
